mods.name: Nativium
mods.description: Metal rendering backend for Minecraft on Apple Silicon. Runs vanilla, Sodium and Fabric rendering mods on Metal.

releases.notes:
Nativium renders Minecraft 26.3 through Apple's **Metal** API on Apple Silicon Macs, compatible with Sodium, Iris shader packs, Voxy and Distant Horizons.

## Install

1. Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 26 or newer, Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Java 25, Fabric API.
2. Put `nativium-1.0.0.jar` into your instance's `mods/` folder. Sodium 0.9.x is recommended; Iris 1.11.6+ is optional for shader packs.
3. Start the game. F3 shows a "Nativium ..." line when Metal is active.

One jar contains everything: the Metal backend, `nativium-gl` (OpenGL → Metal for mods like Voxy), the `nativium-iris` shader-pack adapter (LGPL-3.0, separate nested jar) and Voxy's macOS natives. On Windows, Linux or Intel Macs it does nothing. Details: [docs/RELEASE.md](https://github.com/Crash09N/nativium/blob/main/docs/RELEASE.md).

## Highlights

- Metal is the default engine on Apple Silicon; Sodium runs natively on Metal.
- Iris shader packs on Metal, including compute shaders, SSBOs and geometry shaders (which macOS OpenGL cannot run): Complementary Reimagined/Unbound, Photon 1.3b/1.4, BSL, Bliss, Rethinking Voxels.
- Voxy runs on macOS (it cannot on Apple's OpenGL 4.1), also under shader packs and with Voxy Server Side; Distant Horizons under shader packs.
- Compatibility center: start-up mod scan, status screen, automatic OpenGL fallback instead of crash loops.

## Performance (M3 Max, 2560x1440 fullscreen, VSync off, Sodium)

| Scene | Metal | OpenGL |
|---|---|---|
| Light (render distance 12) | 1541 fps | 602 fps |
| Render distance 32 | 500 fps | 308 fps |
| Complementary Reimagined | 98 fps | 80 fps |
| Voxy + Photon 1.4 | 63 fps | cannot run |

Full table: [docs/benchmarks/release-2026-10-24.md](https://github.com/Crash09N/nativium/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/release-2026-10-24.md).

## Known limits

Voxy LOD water seam (upstream Voxy), weaker enchantment glint under shader packs (same on OpenGL), tessellation shaders and mipmapped shadow maps not supported, nativium-gl covers a subset of OpenGL. Full list: [docs/RELEASE.md](https://github.com/Crash09N/nativium/blob/main/docs/RELEASE.md#known-limits-100-from-docsstatusmd).

Upgrading from Metallium: remove the old `metallium-*.jar`; settings are copied over on the first start.

**Next (in planning):** Apple-native features (MetalFX upscaling, frame interpolation, Game Mode) and an NVIDIA path.

Licence: MIT (the `nativium-iris` adapter is LGPL-3.0). Credits: [README](https://github.com/Crash09N/nativium#credits--licenses).
